high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene of a large, illuminated structure that appears to be a dome or a stadium, possibly part of an event or festival. The structure is adorned with numerous lights, creating a starry effect on its surface. Surrounding the dome are various buildings and structures, some of which are also lit up, contributing to the overall brightness of the scene. The setting appears to be near a body of water, as there is a reflection of the lights on the water's surface, adding to the visual appeal.
